content.text:
### Scope note

Most HUD chrome (bankroll, bet row, spin button, meter stack, item picker anchors) lives in **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test.tscn`** with **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test.gd`**. That `.tscn` is **not** under `combat/scenes`, but it is what you will move/reparent for “top / bottom / left / right” layout. Under `combat/scenes`, the playfield is almost entirely **`combat_root.tscn`**.

---

### Highest impact (do these first)

| File | Why it matters for your spec | Key nodes / symbols / functions |
|------|------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd`** | Owns the **5×5** logic today (`GridManager.COLS/ROWS`), **slot grid** (`$GridUI`), **centering** via `fit_to_viewport`, **line resolve FX** including **`play_win_popup`** on anchor cells, **multiplier** (`CombatMultiplier`, `_refresh_multiplier_label`), **premium meter** (`get_meter_sections_filled()`, signals `premium_meter_changed`, `meter_full_transition_started`), **bet ladder** (`BET_LADDER`, `set_bet_index`, `step_bet`). A true **3×3 playfield** implies changes propagating from here (and constants elsewhere). | Nodes: `grid_ui` (`GridContainer`), `multiplier_label`, `grid_frame`, `grid_flash_overlay`, `power intro` layer, `round_winnings_label`, `winnings_overlay_*`. Functions: `fit_to_viewport`, `_ensure_symbol_slots`, `_play_count_flash_for_lines` (calls `play_win_popup`), `_refresh_multiplier_label`, `get_meter_sections_filled`, `readouts_progressed` emission. |
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scenes\combat_root.tscn`** | Scene defines **`GridUI`** `columns = 5` and fixed rects for frame/flash/overlays sized to that grid; must match script layout and **3×3** if you shrink the model. | Nodes: `GridUI`, `GridFrame`, `GridFlashOverlay`, `PowerIntroLayer`, `MultiplierLabel`, `RoundWinningsLabel`, `WinningsOverlayBar`, `WinningsOverlayLabel`. |
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test.gd`** + **`...\combat\combat_test.tscn`** | Primary **shell UI**: **`%BankrollLabel`** (remove), **`BetMinusButton` / `BetPlusButton` / `BetLabel`** (replace with **segmented bet chips**), **`%SpinButton`** (move to bottom band), **`%PremiumMeterCircle`** + **`%MultiplierReadout`** (meter + multiplier placement; **ProgressBar** likely added here and driven from combat), **`_build_item_picker()`** (`ItemPickerPanel` currently anchored **left** — move to **right**), **`%GoalLabel`**, dev **`TopLeftSeed`**. | Unique names: `%SpinButton`, `%BetMinusButton`, `%BetPlusButton`, `%BetLabel`, `%PremiumMeterCircle`, `%MultiplierReadout`, `%BankrollLabel`, `%BudgetLabel` (“SPIN LOG”), `%CombatRoot`. Functions: `_refresh_readouts`, `_on_premium_meter_changed`, `_layout_combat` → `combat.fit_to_viewport(size)`. |

---

### High impact if “3×3 frame” means a **3×3 symbol grid** (not just centered chrome)

| File | Why |
|------|-----|
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\grid_manager.gd`** | **`COLS` / `ROWS` = 5** — all population, gravity, bounds. |
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\line_detector.gd`** | **`ROWS` / `COLS` = 5** — must stay consistent with `GridManager`. |
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\cluster_detector.gd`** | Comments say it **must match** `GridManager` dimensions. |
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\princess_controller.gd`** | Iterates **`GridManagerScript.ROWS/COLS`** for powers; safe if it always reads from `GridManager`, but any hardcoded geometry assumptions need a pass. |

---

### Targeted impact for **removing per-symbol win number popups**

| File | Why |
|------|-----|
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd`** | **`_play_count_flash_for_lines`** calls `anchor_slot.play_win_popup(...)` with formatted payout text. |
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\symbol_slot.gd`** | **`play_win_popup`**, **`WinPopupLabel`**, `_win_tween`; either remove calls from root or no-op here. |

---

### “Progress bar linked to premium meter”

| File | Why |
|------|-----|
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\premium_meter_circle.gd`** | Current readout is a **3-segment ring** (`filled_sections`, `_visual_sections`, `animate_to_sections`). A **linear `ProgressBar`** would typically sit in **`combat_test.tscn`** and track **`combat.get_meter_sections_filled()`** (0–3 → `ratio`) and/or mirror **`premium_meter_changed`**. |
| **`combat_test.gd`** | Already wires **`_on_premium_meter_changed`** and **`meter_circle.animate_to_sections`** — extend that to a **`ProgressBar`**. |

There is **no dedicated “matched symbol log”** in summaries today (`_empty_spin_summary` is aggregate only). A **left log** likely needs **new UI in `combat_test.gd`** plus either **new signals** from `combat_root.gd** (e.g. per-line match events) or consuming existing debug helpers like **`_summarize_lines`** during resolve (implementation choice).

---

### Lower impact under `combat/scenes`

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scenes\symbol.tscn`** | Base **`SymbolSlot`** + **`Icon`**; minor unless you change default slot size/theme. |
| **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scenes\goal_hud.tscn`** | Small standalone HUD; **only** if you fold goal text into the new layout instead of `GoalLabel` on `CombatTest`. |

---

### Summary order of work

1. **`combat_root.gd` / `combat_root.tscn`** — grid dimensions (if 3×3), layout math, remove/stop win popups, possibly expose log data.  
2. **`combat_test.tscn` / `combat_test.gd`** — shell layout (chips, spin, multiplier panel, progress bar, items right, bankroll gone, symbol log).  
3. **`symbol_slot.gd`** — popup teardown if root still calls it.  
4. **`grid_manager.gd` + `line_detector.gd` + `cluster_detector.gd`** — iff grid size changes.  
5. **`premium_meter_circle.gd`** — optional vs. adding a separate **`ProgressBar`** in the shell.
